hook: Six hundred years of science chased a gold-making myth that never existed.

sections.voiceover: Six hundred years of science chased a gold-making myth that never existed.
Parisian records from the 15th century show Nicolas Flamel working as a scribe. How did Nicolas Flamel amass the real wealth recorded in his will?
However, his surviving will proves Paris scribe Nicolas Flamel had ordinary origins.

Historians at the Musée de Cluny opened an exhibition displaying Nicolas Flamel. Book sales built the estate of scribe Nicolas Flamel in Paris. No philosopher's stone touched the Paris workshop of Nicolas Flamel.
Read the 2026 exhibition papers to see the real documents.
